news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS technology (IB-Stim), adding regional health plan coverage representing over 500,000 covered lives and expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region. CEO Brian Carrico said the new regional health plan coverage broadens patient access and strengthens the company's reimbursement network.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it will report summarized financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026 on August 11, 2026 before market open, followed by a conference call at 9:00 am ET to review the results and provide a business update.

news.headline: Neuraxis declares Q2 stock dividend on Series B preferred
news.summary: NeurAxis's board declared its second-quarter 2026 dividend on Series B Preferred Stock payable entirely in shares of common stock (roughly 80,463 new shares) rather than cash, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38 per share. The dividend is payable July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving company cash while modestly diluting common shareholders.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release and conference call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will release summarized second-quarter 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open and host a conference call at 9:00 am ET to discuss results and provide a business update. Sell-side consensus reportedly models roughly $2.0M in Q2 revenue.

catalysts.label: Targeted path to cash-flow breakeven
catalysts.detail: Management has previously guided toward reaching cash-flow breakeven during 2026, contingent on continued IB-Stim revenue growth following the new AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS effective January 1, 2026.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion for IB-Stim
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis continues to pursue additional commercial and Medicaid payer medical policy coverage decisions state-by-state, most recently adding over 500,000 covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic region on August 4, 2026, building on the Category I CPT code that took effect January 1, 2026.

pulse: NeurAxis is a small-cap medtech commercializing IB-Stim, an FDA-cleared percutaneous electrical nerve field stimulation (PENFS) device for functional abdominal pain in pediatric/adolescent IBS and functional dyspepsia patients, alongside newer adult offerings like the Rectal Expulsion Device. The company continues to add incremental payer coverage (most recently over 500,000 Mid-Atlantic covered lives on August 4, 2026) as it builds on the new AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective January 1, 2026), with Q1 2026 revenue up 80% year-over-year to $1.6M, though it still carries a going-concern qualification and funds itself partly via an at-the-market equity program that dilutes shareholders. The stock has been volatile, pulling back from a 52-week high near $9.33, with the August 11, 2026 Q2 earnings release seen as the next key test of whether the CPT-code-driven revenue ramp and path toward 2026 cash-flow breakeven are staying on track.
